id: title:charlesvien:support disable model invocation skill frontmatter

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new optional boolean field `disableModelInvocation` and its associated metadata support to the PostHog Desktop client's skill management and export interfaces, allowing users to configure and preserve a preference to disable model invocation for specific AI skills.
review.reason: The change introduces a new optional configuration field (`disableModelInvocation`) across the PostHog Desktop client's skill-related Zod schemas and metadata structures. This allows the desktop application to accept, serialize, and preserve a user preference regarding whether a specific AI skill should invoke its underlying model. The implementation is localized to the Desktop SDK
review.uncertainty: The exact runtime behavior and dependency on this flag are not demonstrated in the provided code; the change establishes the data structure and metadata support, but not the complete execution path or its impact on the broader PostHog ecosystem.
